name: open-properties
what_it_holds: CLI/MCP-server/AI-agent-skill tool normalizing live queries across 9 providers in 9 countries: Rightmove/Zoopla/ESPC (UK), Daft.ie (Ireland), ImmoScout24 (Germany), RentCast (US), REALTOR.ca DDF (Canada), Domain (Australia), Idealista (Spain/Italy/Portugal). Queries live APIs, does not persist a dataset; some providers need API keys, three (Rightmove, Daft.ie, ImmoScout24) work anonymously. MIT license, 27 commits.
why_useful: Single tool spanning most of the theme's target sites at once (incl. Australia and Germany); could be the fastest path to a standardized multi-country LTR pull if the team ever needs one comparable panel.

name: cleaning-RWI-GEO-RED
what_it_holds: R scripts to clean and construct hedonic price/rent indices from RWI-GEO-RED — the Research Data Center Ruhr's (FDZ Ruhr, RWI Essen) academic microdata product built from ImmoScout24 real-estate listings (sale + rental, apartments and houses) at German district / labor-market-region level, panel back to 2007-2021 in the repo's example config. Raw data itself is restricted-access, obtained directly from FDZ Ruhr (https://www.rwi-essen.de/en/research-advice/further/research-data-center-ruhr-fdz), not committed to the repo; only cleaning/index-construction code is here.
why_useful: Points to the most rigorous, longest-running (2007+) academic German rental/housing microdata panel available, built from ImmoScout24 — a much longer, quality-adjusted hedonic-rent-index construction than any raw scraper gives, and a genuine academic-replication-package angle. Restricted access (registration/approval needed via FDZ Ruhr), so flagged as a pointer, not an immediate pull.
size_hint: national German ImmoScout24 microdata panel (millions of listings, per FDZ Ruhr documentation); this repo is code-only
license: none declared (code); underlying RWI-GEO-RED data is restricted/academic-access

name: zillowdata
what_it_holds: Committed zip-code-level Zillow datasets including Zip_Zri_MultiFamilyResidenceRental — i.e. a stored extract of the Zillow Rent Index (ZORI/ZRI) at zip-code granularity, monthly, with example series shown for Chicago zips (60606, 60657, 60614).
why_useful: Zillow's own rent index (ZORI/ZRI) is named explicitly in gap #13 (Zillow ZORI/Redfin/Apartment List/Realtor.com); this repo has an actual committed zip-level extract rather than just a link to Zillow Research, though it is a small/old snapshot repo and Zillow Research's live data page is a better primary source going forward.
